chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Vows Revenge with the Buried Bow – Chapter 570 of World of Immortality
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen acquires the legendary Buried Bow from a dying Ancestral God, swearing to kill the Otherworld gods. A tense hunt in the star palace leads to bloodshed and a mysterious stone woman.
og_title: World of Immortality Chapter 570 – The Buried Bow's Promise
og_description: A tragic vow drives Xiao Chen deeper into the star palace, where he faces the White Ancestral God and uncovers the Lotus King.
twitter_title: The Buried Bow Awakens in Chapter 570
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's promise to a fallen god leads to deadly arrow strikes and an encounter with the Stone Lotus King.
